Georgia Tech at Clemson
Freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds and the Tigers (6-3, 4-2 ACC) host the Yellow Jackets (2-7, 1-5). Reynolds has rushed for 209 yards and two TDs in his last three games. Georgia Tech snapped a nine-game series slide with a 24-21 triumph in 2025.

The Texas State Bobcats (5-4, 3-2 Pac-12) host the Fresno State Bulldogs (5-4, 2-3 Pac-12) at UFCU Stadium in San Marcos. Fresno State relies on quarterback Jayden Mandal, while Texas State looks to quarterback Brad Jackson who enters with 19 TDs.

title: College Football
description:

The New Mexico Lobos (8-1) host the UNLV Rebels (5-4) at University Stadium in Albuquerque for a Mountain West game. New Mexico is first in the conference after topping Nevada 31-3, while UNLV sits fifth following a 41-35 loss to Wyoming.
